dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Yes. There was a big pile of fruits next to me when I woke up. Some were sweet, and some were sour, and some were really difficult to bite into. Oh, some of them spurted juice all over my clothes when I bit them. Fortunately, I was next to a river, so I could wash my clothes there.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder when Bluey will finish with whatever she's doing. I miss her and Big Sis Fujin...
